what: The Jangan plaza landmark, finalized: the golden dragon statue (Meshy M1 fitted to the retail statue + a gold sro-remaster map set) and the new fountain basin (bmesh, v2) inside the plaza model. Critique pass of work/tmp/dragon; integration: work/tmp/dragon/INTEGRATE.md.

meshyCredits.balance: 1,840 -> 1,730 (no Meshy jobs in the critique pass)

dragon.space: cj_jang_gate_dragon glTF model space: same origin, axes and metres as the retail glb; the placement transform is unchanged
dragon.pivot: the retail model origin (the placement position); no offset
dragon.source: Meshy multi-image-to-3d M1 (4 retail turnaround renders, meshy-7.1, 30 credits), cleaned and ICP-fitted to the retail mesh (rigid + uniform scale), decimated per LOD

footprint.note: radii from the basin centre; entirely inside the inner wall, nothing walkable

dragon.lodNote: The world renderer has no per-object LOD for buildings (one glb per model; placements batch per region with a 202 m draw range for group 2). Ship LOD0 on every preset; LOD1 is the fallback if the Medium frame check fails; the distances are for a future per-object LOD hook. LOD2 (3k) is also a shadow / far proxy.

materials.image: cj_jang_dragon_m1 (embedded 512 JPEG: the Low / retail-tier fallback)
materials.textureKey: prim\mtrl\bldg\china\jangan01\cj_jang_dragon_m1.ddj (a new key: no texpipe set needed)
materials.lightmap: none (no retail-like bake: the Meshy surface baked to noise; the gold set carries the shading)

remaster.maps: albedo (sRGB), normal (glTF/OpenGL green), metallic (R), roughness (R); 2048 full + @1024; sizes [1024] -> Medium/High @1024, Ultra 2048
remaster.derivation: Meshy M1 maps; gold told from rock and the jade pearl by hue/saturation: gold metallic 0.6-0.8 (median 0.8), roughness 0.26-0.55 (median 0.389), gold albedo x1.08; rock metal 0, rough >= 0.8; pearl metal 0, rough 0.3 (scripts/m1_pbr.py). A full-metal set (0.78-0.95, no lift) read olive and dim at night and in rain and was rejected (previews/ingame_gold_variants.jpg)

waterfall.change: none: it starts 0.50 m from the M1 mouth (inside the fall width); town/fx.ts keys the spray and ripple rings on cj_wf_dr_03-05

fountain.space: cj_jang_gate glTF model space; the octagon centre at (x, z) = (2.99275, 0.99425), faces at k*45 deg; plaza level y 0.05, water y 0.007
fountain.pivot: the retail plaza model origin; no offset

dropIn.note: SHIP: the retail gate06/07/08 meshes (byte-identical, retail lightmaps) + the fountain LOD0

pieces: basin: pool floor (y -0.965), inner wall at apothem 8.76 (as retail), moulded coping (top y 0.88, a 4 cm lip), outer wall with pilasters and recessed framed panels (two per span), a two-tier plinth step; everything above the water in the warm pond-fence slab stone
rail: 16 posts (pond-fence carved strip) with gourd finials, sills, framed rail panels, vase balusters, round handrails
pillar base: a sumeru base under the statue (apothem 4.70 -> 4.62, top y 0.34) with carved waist panels and a lotus band (LOD0); mostly inside the M1 rock
fountain.nav: unchanged and cannot change: nav.bin is built from the retail .bms navmeshes; the gate navmesh blocks an octagon at apothem 9.584-9.844; the basin reaches 9.54 (LOD0/1) / 9.50 (LOD2) above the plaza, retail fence 9.614

materials.image: cj_jang_gate06 (retail, byte-identical: deduped in the plaza glb)
materials.use: the pool floor, the inner wall below the water, the pillar base

everything above the water: coping, plinth, outer wall, recess panels, inner wall above the water, posts, caps, finials, sills, balusters, rail panels, handrails (plain stone from the slab row, v 0.145-0.325)
materials.pbrSet: B2 batch (content/texpipe/b2-town.json) once run; painterly gates passed (grain 174 %, dLum +0.66)

materials.use: the pillar base waist panels only

fountain.materialColours: BMT diffuse = ambient = 150/255 (the plaza's), flags 320, OPAQUE, single-sided (glTF doubleSided false), TEXCOORD_1 kept

lightmaps.uri: lightmaps/remaster/plaza/fountain_lod<n>_lightmap.png (relative to the world manifest; optimize-out makes it .webp)
lightmaps.bake: Cycles AO (plaza ring as occluder) on TEXCOORD_1, stored as 0.75 + 0.2 * AO on a white background with 6-texel island margins and a 16-texel extension: the PBR path reads an object lightmap as sun visibility, saturate((lm - 0.55) / 0.4), plus an AO share, so open stone keeps the full sun (0.95, the retail in-sun value) and the deepest crease half of it

water.used: the region terrain water (region 25000, blocks (2,2) and (3,2), -3.3 m; town water shader, rain ripples, reflection) - unchanged

piece.status: optional, not used: an extra disc over the region water would double its reflection and hide the ripples

critiqueFixes: dragon: a gold sro-remaster set (metal class, Meshy-derived metallic / roughness / normal; 1024 + 2048). The build pass staged the M1 matte (class default), which read almost like retail in game
dragon + fountain: glTF doubleSided false (Blender exported true: the region batch emitted every triangle twice, +72k instead of +35k triangles, and drew back faces)
plaza drop-in + fountain: TEXCOORD_1 kept (gltf-transform prune() dropped the lightmap UVs of every plaza mesh, the retail paving pieces included, in the build pass glb)

fountain v3 geometry: a 4 cm coping lip instead of 13 cm (the sun cascaded shadow striped the outer wall), warm pond-fence slab stone above the water (gate06 drew cool blue-grey), the slab band moved off the texture dark seam line, framed panels in the recesses
fountain lightmaps re-baked (0.75 + 0.2 AO on white, wide margins, 256 / 128) and the sidecar strings fixed (v1 wrote backspace / form-feed control characters into source and lightmap paths)
the dragon glbs embed a 512 albedo (the Low / retail fallback) instead of a 2048 JPEG; the gold set brings 1024 / 2048

dragonMedium.files: @1024 albedo + normal + metallic + roughness (metal and rough packed into one ORMH at runtime)

textures.fountain: no new texture keys except pondfen (512 master, 0.4 MB PNG in the glb until texpipe); gate06/gate08 shared with the plaza

downloads.note: before optimize-out (meshopt + webp shrink them further)

budgets.frameTimeSummary: Lab (work/tmp/dragon/lab, the real loadWorld on out-opt, Medium, 1600x900, GPU lock 16:24-16:58): WebGPU, CPU+GPU synced per frame (onSubmittedWorkDone), p50 of 400 frames: plaza view retail 5.5 / 5.9 / 6.1 / 6.9 ms (4 runs) vs final 5.6 / 6.9 (2 runs); at the rail 5.3-6.5 vs 5.6-7.0; LOD1 pair 6.6 / 5.9. WebGL2 (readPixels sync): plaza 3.4 / 3.6 vs 3.5, rail 3.4 / 3.7 vs 3.5. CPU submit 1.2-2.1 ms both. Draws per frame unchanged (100 plaza, 96-97 rail). The difference is inside the run-to-run noise (about 1 ms); the 60 fps budget is 16.7 ms. RDNA4 desktop GPU: the integration lane re-runs LAB G1 on its gated scenes.
budgets.lodRecommendation: Ship LOD0 for both pieces on every preset (+35k triangles in view, no new draws). If LAB G1 on the gate machine misses on Medium, ship the LOD1 pair (dragon 12k, plaza with fountain 3.2k: +12k triangles).
